decision_title: Worker adapters spawn each harness's CLI, not its SDK
decision_reason: One prompt out, one run back keeps the Worker trait one-shot (PHEOBE-9). Codex and Claude SDKs are CLI wrappers so one kit serves both; Cursor's @cursor/sdk is its own Connect-RPC agent loop, so the cursor kit ships a file form (.cursor/agents/pheobe.md) plus an SDK variant (PHEOBE-23). In-process SDK workers (steering, live USD) are a later trait extension.
summary: Decision: Worker adapters spawn each harness's CLI, not its SDK

rejected_alternatives.option: in-process SDK bindings per harness (Node/Python shims)

decision_title: Report mechanical fields are always pheobe's; only contract keys merge from an engine's JSON tail
decision_reason: branch, commits (git log base..HEAD since provision) and tests are measured, never narrated. ok/summary/next_steps/doubts/blocked merge from the engine's final JSON — bare, fenced, or embedded (worker::extract_json_tail, PHEOBE-22). Found live: a claude run's commit was missing and its fenced report collapsed to prose before this.
summary: Decision: Report mechanical fields are always pheobe's; only contract keys merge from an engine's JSON tail

decision_title: Never cook in the source checkout — worktree or blocked:no_isolation
decision_reason: Provision kitchen > buckets > git worktree add; the parent merges, pheobe never pushes a protected branch. Host mode gets the same kitchen via pheobe host setup/finish (PHEOBE-26); a run that dies before the model turn tears its empty worktree down (issue 04).
summary: Decision: Never cook in the source checkout — worktree or blocked:no_isolation

decision_title: Release channel: version moves with the work; publish the tagged commit
decision_reason: release.yml bumps from conventional-commit subjects (feat→minor, fix→patch, !→major, docs/chore no-op), pushes the bump commit BEFORE the tag (zorro#128 ordering), then publish.yml publishes exactly the tagged commit to crates.io (api-drift precedent, Trusted Publishing first). First release is a hand tag v0.1.0. No path/git deps (RULES §5) so the tarball builds alone.
summary: Decision: Release channel: version moves with the work; publish the tagged commit

decision_title: LOC budget 500 soft / 1000 hard per source file
decision_reason: Fleet doctrine adopted in PHEOBE-21 after tests.rs hit 1444: tests live in src/tests/<area>.rs, a file that would cross 1000 is split, not grown.
summary: Decision: LOC budget 500 soft / 1000 hard per source file

decision_title: Live coordination is scripts/pheobe-sync; decisions here, status on the board
decision_reason: jokersquad agent-sync, one JSONL per primary checkout shared by worktrees (PHEOBE-24) — three agents landed on main in one afternoon with no channel before it. The channel is the conversation; .dejavue/ holds decisions; .jagent/planning/ holds status.
summary: Decision: Live coordination is scripts/pheobe-sync; decisions here, status on the board

v0.1.0 tagged on nixpt/pheobe (public); crates.io publish pending a fresh token. 129 tests; self/host modes + six worker adapters + ACP + adoption kits; release + publish workflows live; sync channel live. Open: issues 04(done)/10, knowledge drive mechanics (PHEOBE-29), Trusted Publishing after first publish.

decision_reason: Trusted Publishing configured on the pheobe crate for nixpt/pheobe publish.yml and proven with the verify_auth dispatch (2026-09-16); the CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN repo secret was deleted. A future token is only needed for a first publish of a NEW crate.
